applicability_label: Minnesota June-bearing strawberries; confirm local conditions.
title: Check spring strawberry mulch
instructions: From early April, check June-bearing strawberries and remove or reduce straw when growth, soil conditions, and the forecast support spring growth.
source_title: Adding and removing straw mulch for strawberries

applicability_label: Minnesota June-bearing strawberries; wait for dormancy.
title: Mulch dormant strawberries
instructions: In late fall, wait until June-bearing strawberries are dormant before applying protective straw mulch; Minnesota guidance places this check in November through December.
source_title: Adding and removing straw mulch for strawberries

applicability_label: Minnesota established asparagus; confirm plant age locally.
title: Let asparagus ferns grow
instructions: After the June 30 harvest stop, let established asparagus plants grow their ferns to support the next season; follow local guidance for plants grown from crowns or seed.
